[EN] Killing a cromos or defeating a naga is certainly an accomplishment, in a way.

Defeating a peer, however, someone equal to yourself—that's where the real test lies!
[ES] Matar a un cromos o derrotar a un naga es sin duda un logro, en cierto modo.

Sin embargo, derrotar a un rival, alguien igual a ti, ¡ahí es donde reside la verdadera prueba!
